bed-winter-dry.prompt: Create ONE winter variant of the exact Buzzle garden-bed sprite in reference. Reference controls geometry: LOW LONG rectangular trough, softly rounded bevelled corners, honey-golden faceted rim and short amber front wall, width about3.5 times total height, near-front slightly elevated garden camera. Do not make a square planter, raised tall box or isometric diamond. Same warm honey-crystal low-poly3D materials and broad clean facets as reference. Add THREE small soft ivory-white snow caps only on far-left BACK corner, far-right BACK corner and a small portion of front-left outer edge, with restrained pale blue facet shadows. Keep most amber rim visible, center open and all soil uncovered for placing flower sprites. DRY soil: medium warm cinnamon-brown broad polygon clumps, matte and fairly light, no blue shine or frost on soil. No plants, seeds, sprouts, rocks sticking up, tools, ornaments, Christmas ribbons, falling snow, background or ground/cast shadow. Single isolated EMPTY garden bed centered on a transparent landscape canvas, entire rim visible with generous transparent margins. True transparent background. Warm upper-left light; snow must feel cozy not icy glass. Asset only, no text, labels or contact sheet.
